dialogue.user: I'm interested in learning more about the **Crocs Unisex-Child Kids' Classic All Terrain Clog**. You mentioned it has a rugged tread pattern and rubber pods for traction and support, which sounds great for outdoor activities. Can you tell me more about its features and what customers have to say about it in their reviews? I'm also curious about the sizing and materials used.
dialogue.agent:
The **Crocs Unisex-Child Kids' Classic All Terrain Clog** features a rugged tread pattern and rubber pods for traction and support, making it suitable for outdoor activities. It's made from lightweight Croslite foam construction and has ventilation ports for breathability. The shoe also has an adjustable turbo strap and a pivoting heel strap for a more secure fit. Additionally, you can personalize the shoe with Jibbitz shoe charms.

Here are some reviews from customers:

* "I purchased these crocs for my son who wears an AFO to help with some ventilation during the summer. They are wide enough for brace to slide in. I purchased three different styles but these worked best because of the Velcro adjustable straps." (5/5 rating)
* "I like the quick on-off of the shoe. I dislike the foot bed, because the texture could be a problem for a super sensitive child. Nonetheless a convenient, airy slip on." (4/5 rating)
* "Getting these crocs from Amazon beats buying them from the actual online store. I got the shoes within 2 days versus 3 weeks when I ordered mine from the actual store. I bought a size up for my kiddo just so he could have room to grow since he is only 5. The straps are adjustable so even though they are too big, I adjusted the strap to tighten on his heel so the shoe didn’t feel too big. He loves them!! I would highly recommend!!!" (5/5 rating)

Crocs recommends ordering a size up to the next largest whole size for a relaxed fit. 

Would you like to compare this shoe with other options or make a purchase?
